text.p: NYNEX Corp Chief Executive, Ivan Seidenberg, said he expects that the combined Bell Atlantic Corp-NYNEX Corp will try to increase combined earnings per share growth to 10 to 12 percent per year and shareholder return, including dividends, of 15 to 20 percent.

"We hope to rachet up combined earnings per share growth to 10 to 12 percent," Seidenberg told a Salomon Brothers investment conference. "We believe we have to provide total shareholder return of 15 to 20 percent to satisfy people like you," Seidenberg told the investor audience.
As a stand-alone entity. NYNEX currently has a target of earnings per share growth of seven to 10 percent.
Seidenberg said both NYNEX and Bell Atlantic in recent quarters had been growing at the upper end of their earnings target ranges. He did not give the Bell Atlantic range.
He said the merger was on track for early 1997 completion and said the Department of Justice had told him it expected to finish its review in the next two or three weeks.
"The Justice Departement says they are down to the last leg," Seidenberg said. He said he was confident there would be no problems arising from that review.
